summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market purchases of its own shares under an existing buyback programme announced 20 May 2025. From 27-31 July 2026 it bought 195,390 ordinary shares at an average of about €24.76 and 82,192 ADS-underlying shares at about $29.35, all for cancellation. The company acts as issuer, not a target or acquirer, and no premium, advisor, or board recommendation applies. The programme is ongoing, with purchases to be cancelled. Watch for continued weekly volume and the programme's remaining capacity, though no risk-arb angle applies as this is a routine capital return disclosure.
